"import csv
from openpyxl import Workbook

INPUT_FILE = "eng_si_01.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "output.xlsx"
HEADER = ["run", "force_n", "length_mm", "temp_c"]

wb = Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "SI"
ws.append(HEADER)

with open(INPUT_FILE, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        run_id = row["run"]
        force_lbf = float(row["force_lbf"])
        length_in = float(row["length_in"])
        temp_f = float(row["temp_f"])

        force_n = round(force_lbf * 4.4482216152605, 3)
        length_mm = round(length_in * 25.4, 3)
        temp_c = round((temp_f - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0, 3)

        ws.append([run_id, force_n, length_mm, temp_c])

wb.save(OUTPUT_FILE)
print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT_FILE} with sheet 'SI' ({ws.max_row - 1} data rows)")"
